description: Call first. Answers the questions this document’s own views say a session starts from — what is ready to start, what is open, the latest entries — each with the `format_rows` call that lists it whole; then what a row of each format looks like, enough to write one; and where new work begins: `formats`, then `read_onto_format` (files or a folder of notes) or `declare_format`. Read-only.
